Name: LOAD_BALANCER_DRAW_DIST_SCALE_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the draw distance scale configuration for the FPS load balancer.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance Scale: Level 00
Fields.Description: Distance multiplier used while the load level is 0 (1 = unchanged, below 1 = shorter distances).
